parsed.post: The latest experiment with current hyperparameters yielded 0.895556, which is worse than our current best (0.875238). Reverting to the 663b6f0 configuration. I suspect the current learning rate (0.06) or batch size might be slightly too high for the stability we've seen. I will attempt to lower the learning rate and increase weight decay in the next attempt.
parsed.description: Lowering learning rate to 0.04 and introducing a small weight decay of 0.01 to prevent overfitting and improve generalization.
